statement.text:
The class LN Mp of locally nilpotent groups admitting a splitting automor-
phism of prime order p (for definition see 10.59) is a variety of groups with operators
(E. I. Khukhro, Math. USSR Sbornik, 58 (1987), 119–126). Is it true that
                     LN Mp = (Nc(p) ∩ LN Mp ) ∨ (Bp ∩ LN Mp )
where Nc(p) is the variety of nilpotent groups of some p-bounded class c(p) and Bp
is the variety of groups of exponent p?                               E. I. Khukhro
